_meta.description: BBMP Building Bye-Laws 2003 — Rules applicable to Multi-Dwelling Residential Apartments

rules.title: Minimum Plot Area for Apartment
rules.error_message: Plot area {actual} sqm is below the minimum {expected} sqm required for apartment construction.
rules.recommendation: Plot area must be at least 150 sqm for multi-unit apartment developments.
rules.explanation: Apartments require larger minimum plot area than independent houses to accommodate shared amenities and setbacks.

rules.title: Minimum Abutting Road Width for Apartment
rules.error_message: Abutting road width {actual} m is below minimum {expected} m required for apartment complexes.
rules.recommendation: Apartment buildings require a minimum road width of 9.0 m to ensure emergency access and traffic flow.
rules.explanation: Multi-family residential buildings increase traffic volume and require wider access roads for fire tenders.

rules.title: Parking Ratio per Dwelling Unit
rules.error_message: Parking ratio {actual} spaces/unit is below the required {expected} spaces/unit.
rules.recommendation: Provide at least 1 off-street parking space per dwelling unit.
rules.explanation: Every apartment unit must have at least one dedicated car parking stall.

rules.title: High-Rise All-Around Setback (> 4 Storeys)
rules.error_message: High-rise setback {actual} m is below the minimum all-around setback of {expected} m.
rules.recommendation: Provide at least 6.0 m clear setback on all 4 sides for high-rise apartment towers.
rules.explanation: High-rise buildings require 6m all-around clearance for fire tender movement and structural isolation.

rules.title: Lift Requirement (> G+3 / 15m)
rules.error_message: Lift is required for apartment buildings above G+3 storeys.
rules.recommendation: Install at least one passenger elevator complying with NBC guidelines.
rules.explanation: Multi-storey residential buildings over 4 floors must provide elevator access for accessibility.

rules.title: Fire NOC Requirement (> 15m Height)
rules.error_message: Fire NOC from Karnataka Fire and Emergency Services is required for high-rise apartments.
rules.recommendation: Obtain Fire NOC prior to plan sanction.
rules.explanation: High-rise apartments must be cleared by Karnataka Fire Services for safety and equipment access.
